annotations.title: Remove a person from the company

description: DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone: removes a person from the company. A joined member loses access to the company and its signature; a pending invitation is withdrawn with the details entered for it. Two steps: called without confirmation it removes nothing and returns who would be removed and a confirmation. Show that to the person, and only after they say yes call again with the confirmation; it expires in 10 minutes. Company owners only. Nobody can remove themselves or the primary owner.

company.description: The company slug (as in its Signatoro URL) or its id.

confirmation.description: Leave out on the first call. After the person approves the removal, the confirmation the first call returned.
